source_family_arguments.conditional_consequence: A retained conclusion is reusable only while its support remains applicable. New behavior can refute a realization or expose a governing gap, but cannot supply the missing owner decision. Correcting a lower surface cannot close an affected upstream gap merely by making tests agree with it.
source_family_arguments.additional_policy_and_owner: Computed treatment owns whether the candidate or governing relation needs correction; Universal Intake Triage owns the resulting change class and re-entry. Renewal and trace closure consume those decisions. ADR fields and layout carry decisions; Ticket owns continuity of judgments and rulings, and each semantic owner decides its own repricing.

obligations: No silent in-place rewriting of live constitutional domain artifacts.
Every material Product/module/function/application/runtime/capability has lifecycle signal or recorded release/deploy/live-use/telemetry/retirement gaps.
The Product selects the realization and observation forms; Code/Events apply where that binding selects them.
Apply supported drift correction through Universal Intake Triage; reprice the governing source when its meaning needs change, not merely because realization violates sufficient law.
